text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning of the Takarazuka Kinen.
From the empty grandstands,
I check the condition of the racecourse turf.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
—I knew you'd be here!
Good morning!!
choice_data_list: Ms. Otonashi!? You're up early, aren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I haven't been able to sleep since last night!
Would it be all right if I got a quick comment from you right now?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Today's favorites... no, those regarded as the top favorites in the entire world, please allow me to interview you about your enthusiasm!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as I told Reporter Otonashi about <chrname>'s
incredible feats while soothing her overexcited reactions,
time slipped away—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, the Takarazuka Kinen!
I wonder who will claim the grand finale of this spring...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious! <chrname>—!
Show them the power that's taking you to the world stage—!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
choice_data_list: I will meet these expectations and show them a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that <chrname> could carry the dream of
"a Japanese Umamusume shining as the best in the world"
upon her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...! Right you are, pardon me.
Have a safe trip!
